name: Error Analysis via Marching Tetrahedra
definition: An error evaluation method based on isosurface extraction using Marching Tetrahedra. It measures the geometric and topological changes in the isosurface when two small tetrahedra are fused into a large one.
summary: Error Analysis via Marching Tetrahedra is a geometric error metric that determines whether two child tetrahedra can be fused into a single parent tetrahedron by explicitly evaluating the displacement of isosurface intersection points along specific segments within the tetrahedron.
